segments.text: Welcome to this week's technology news roundup.
Our top story is a major chip maker announcing a new energy efficient processor.
The company claims the chip cuts power usage by forty percent.
Analysts say the gain comes mostly from a smaller manufacturing process.
In cloud news a provider lowered prices on long term storage.
The price cut targets customers archiving large datasets.
A popular open source database released version fifteen this week.
The release adds native support for parallel query execution.
In security news researchers disclosed a flaw in a widely used library.
A patch is already available and users should update immediately.
On the funding front a robotics startup raised fifty million dollars.
The startup builds warehouse robots for small businesses.
That is all for this week's roundup, see you next time.
